limits: Physical mouse hardware and Win10 native host not tested this round; Chromium sendInputEvent and original Windows11 Typora renderer events verified separately.

Web pages use host Chromium sandbox, not the operating-system default browser engine. CSP/X-Frame-Options, login and special permissions can prevent display; explicit default browser action remains available.
Cross-origin iframe load does not prove successful rendering. Actual HTTP CSP denial/503 and injected observable error are distinct tests.
Window/menu zoom retains its global meaning; preview Ctrl wheel does not issue window zoom.
User windows not restarted; normal restart required. Previously deferred unsaved warning and unrelated outstanding requirements unchanged.
